home.seoTitle: Dar el Bacha — Moroccan fine dining restaurant in Casablanca
home.seoDescription: Dar el Bacha, a Moroccan fine dining restaurant in Casablanca: traditional cuisine, the art of hospitality, and table requests online or via WhatsApp.

hero.title: A grand house for Moroccan cuisine
hero.text: In Casablanca, Dar el Bacha serves Moroccan gastronomy with the care of a fine dining table: traditional recipes, carefully chosen produce, attentive service.

intro.title: An address in Casablanca
intro.text: Dar el Bacha brings together Morocco's culinary heritage and the precision of fine dining. Every visit is meant as an invitation: take your seat, let us look after you, and taste.

philosophy.title: Tradition as a starting point
philosophy.text: Moroccan recipes are passed down through gesture and patience. We serve them with the same respect, in a contemporary presentation that lets the produce speak.

signature.title: Signature dishes
signature.text: A selection from the menu, shown here once the dishes and their photographs have been approved by the restaurant.

experience.title: The time of a meal
experience.text: From your arrival to the end of the meal, every moment follows the rhythm of Moroccan hospitality: attentive, generous, never rushed.

cta.title: Book your table
cta.text: Send a request online or message us on WhatsApp. The restaurant confirms every reservation.

specialties.title: Flavours of the menu
specialties.text: A deliberately concise menu, built around the great classics of Moroccan cuisine.

items.boissons: Moroccan tea, infusions and fresh juices

histoire.seoTitle: Our story — Dar el Bacha, Casablanca
histoire.seoDescription: The identity of Dar el Bacha: traditional Moroccan cuisine, inherited know-how and the art of hospitality in Casablanca.
histoire.title: Our story
histoire.lead: A house devoted to Moroccan cuisine and the art of hospitality.

philosophie.title: Culinary philosophy
philosophie.text: Start from traditional recipes, choose produce with care, then plate each dish with the precision of fine dining.

inspiration.title: Moroccan inspiration
inspiration.text: Spices, slow cooking, almond and orange blossom sweets: Moroccan cuisine offers a remarkably rich repertoire, which the menu explores with restraint.

savoirFaire.title: Know-how and tradition
savoirFaire.text: Some preparations take hours. That time is part of the recipe, and we respect it.

recevoir.title: The art of hospitality
recevoir.text: In Morocco, welcoming guests is a way of honouring them. That sense of hospitality guides our service, from the first word to the last attention.

ambiance.title: The atmosphere
ambiance.text: Soft light, natural materials, crafted details: a setting designed so that the meal unfolds without haste.
